description_en: Renders an avatar video from text or an audio file
description_zh: 以人声音频或文本作为输入，渲染虚拟人视频
kebab_example: aliyun ice submit-avatar-video-job --input-config Text_:_To_be_or_not_to_be,_that_is_the_question. --editing-config AvatarId_:_yunqiao --output-config MediaURL_:_https://your-bucket.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/xxx.mp4 --title Test_title --description Test_description --user-data user_:_data_,_env_:_prod --region cn-hangzhou
name: SubmitAvatarVideoJob

parameters.example: {"Text": "To be or not to be, that is the question."}
parameters.help_en: Input can be text, an audio file from Object Storage Service (OSS), or a [media asset](). Only MP3 and WAV audio formats are supported.><notice> The value of the `Text` parameter must contain at least five characters.></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
虚拟人任务输入参数。支持以文本、音频OSS文件、媒资作为输入。音频仅支持mp3或wav格式。
<notice>Text 的输入内容长度不能少于 5 个字。></notice>
parameters.name: input_config

parameters.help_en: The configurations for the avatar job, such as the avatar ID, voice, and speech rate
parameters.help_zh: 虚拟人任务配置信息，支持设置虚拟人id、人声、语速等信息
parameters.name: editing_config

parameters.help_en: Specifies the output configuration, including the destination URL for the rendered video
parameters.help_zh: 任务输出信息，支持设置输出地址
parameters.name: output_config

parameters.help_en: The title of the job. The title can be up to 128 bytes in length
parameters.help_zh: 任务标题，长度不超过128字节
parameters.name: title

parameters.help_en: The description of the job. The description can be up to 128 bytes in length
parameters.help_zh: 任务描述，长度不超过128字节
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: A user-defined JSON string for passing custom business information, such as environment details or job metadata
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义设置，可传入客户业务信息，如业务方环境、任务信息，JSON字符串格式
parameters.name: user_data

MediaId.description_en: The ID of the output video's [media asset]()
